lei.lead: Elder care, care for people with mental health challenges, and a full range of support services, all under one roof in Pondicherry.
lei.h.p: We provide dedicated residential care for older adults, combining nursing support with comfort, safety and dignity in daily life.
lei.grp1.3: Health Monitoring and Medical Information Management
lei.beat: Amour Total Care Home strives to offer the best elder care and psychiatric care, both in the quality of our care and the number of individuals we serve. Our vision is care, comfort and dignity.
lei.a.tag: Care for People with Mental Health Challenges
lei.a.p: We provide psychiatric-specific management for residents with mental health challenges, in a protected, home-like environment that supports dignity, structure and individual attention.
lei.a.7: Health monitoring and medical information management
lei.f.p: Practical information for families and visitors.
lei.f1.p: Morning: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM. Evening: 4:00 PM – 7:00 PM. Visitors are requested to obtain permission and help maintain a peaceful environment for residents.
lei.f2.p: Meals and beverages are served throughout the day, from morning tea at 6:30 AM to bed milk at 9:00 PM.
lei.f3.p: A nutritionist visits daily to help monitor residents' dietary needs.
lei.f4.p: Medical information is maintained from admission to help track health conditions. A GRBS blood sugar test may be conducted by a nurse during a resident's stay.
lei.f5.p: Boarding and lodging facilities are provided as part of residential care.
lei.f6.p: Personal laundry is included as part of our care services.
lei.f7.p: Pulmonary contusion, hemothorax, pneumothorax, cardiac contusion.
lei.f8.p: Heat and cold injuries, burns, inhalation trauma.
lei.k1.p:
The health insurance fund pays for medical treatment, regardless of the care level:
  • Doctor visits and therapies (physio-, occupational, speech therapy)
  • Hospital treatment
  • Medicines, remedies and aids (e.g. wheelchair, nursing bed – with approval)
  • Home nursing care in case of acute illness or after hospital stay
lei.k2.p: The care insurance fund pays for nursing support in case of need for care (care level required):
lei.k3.p: If the costs of the actual care need exceed the benefits of the above-mentioned cost bearers (care insurance fund), the remaining share of the costs must either be borne privately or — if the requirements are met — covered by various offices (social welfare office, state aid, regional council).
lei.k4.p: An additionally concluded health or accident insurance policy can cover a portion of the incurred costs, depending on the assessment.

faq.lead: Answers to common questions about care at Amour Total Care Home.
faq.q1: Who can stay at Amour Total Care Home?
faq.a1: Amour Total Care Home welcomes older adults and people with mental health challenges. Please contact us to discuss your loved one's specific needs.
faq.q2: What type of care is provided?
faq.a2: We provide elder care and care for people with mental health challenges, including long-term care, end-of-life care, and psychiatric-specific management.
faq.a3: Yes. 24/7 nursing care is provided to all residents, along with doctors' care.
faq.a4: We provide nutritious vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals and beverages throughout the day. A nutritionist visits daily to help monitor residents' dietary needs.
faq.a5: Morning: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM. Evening: 4:00 PM – 7:00 PM. Visitors are requested to obtain permission and help maintain a peaceful environment for residents.
faq.a6: Yes, we provide boarding and lodging facilities as part of residential care.
faq.a7: We offer recreation facilities, indoor games, and outdoor visits, along with Tamil and English daily newspapers and weekly magazines.
faq.q8: How can families contact the home?
faq.a8: You can reach Amour Total Care Home at +91 88071 08378, +91 95006 56777, or 0413-2355779.
faq.top1.p: Round-the-clock nursing support for all residents.
faq.top2.p: Nutritious meals with daily nutritionist visits.
faq.top3.p: Morning 10 AM–12 PM, Evening 4–7 PM daily.
faq.cta.p: Reach out to us directly — we're happy to help.

ub.lead: A non-governmental organisation providing elder care and support for people with mental health challenges in Pondicherry since 2012.
ub.hist.p1: Amour Total Care Home is a non-governmental organisation founded in 2012 in Pondicherry, with a capacity of 40 beds, providing management of both medical and nursing care for older adults and people with mental health challenges.
ub.hist.p2: We have a deep understanding of the needs of seniors and people with mental health challenges. faq.q9: How can I enquire about admission?
faq.a9: Please contact Amour Total Care Home for current information.
faq.q10: Do we have to buy medical equipment ourselves?
faq.a10: No. All medical devices such as ventilators and monitors are provided by the health insurance. We work closely with specialized medical technology companies.
faq.q11: Are nursing staff present at night as well?
faq.a11: Yes. With 24-hour intensive care, a certified nurse is always on-site — including at night — to ensure continuous and safe monitoring.

don.lead: Your support helps us care for older adults and people with mental health challenges in Pondicherry.
don.why.p1: Since 2012, Amour Total Care Home has provided a safe, nurturing home for older adults and people with mental health challenges. Many of our residents come to us with little or no family support.
don.why.p2: Donations help us keep care compassionate and dignified: nutritious meals, medical and nursing support, medicines and a comfortable place to live.
don.use1.p: Nutritious, freshly prepared meals suited to each resident's health needs.
don.use2.p: Medicines, check-ups and round-the-clock nursing support for our residents.
don.use3.p: Clean rooms, bedding, clothing and a warm, safe place to live with dignity.
don.bank.p: You can donate by bank transfer (NEFT / RTGS / IMPS) using the details here. Donations are received by Amour Care Foundation. Tap any value to copy it.
